examples.arabic: الكورة كانت قريبة من شجرة صغيرة
examples.english: The ball was close to a small tree.
examples.transliteration: El kora kanet 'arayyeba min shagara soghayyara.

examples.arabic: شايف شجرة كبيرة برا وناس كتير بتتكلم
examples.english: I see a big tree outside and many people talking.
examples.transliteration: Shayef shagara kebeera barra we nas kiteer betetkallem.

examples.arabic: سال جدته ايه الشجرة الكبيرة دي
examples.english: He asked his grandma, 'What is that big tree?'
examples.transliteration: Sa'al geddetoh eih el shagara el kebeera di?
